title: Latin Cognates - AL Endings
description: Discover stress, vowel consistency, es and no; derive cognates and related vocabulary.
reviewNotes: Restores omitted stress discoveries, es natural, no, fatal, natal, colonial, festival, personal and total.
Corrects obvious ASR spellings (S -> es, dente -> diente, Anuel -> anual); final review against original recording remains required.
Removes synthetic outro and transfer prompt absent from original transcript.
Text responses demonstrate lexical/structural understanding, not verified acoustic pronunciation.

steps.text: English and Spanish are related languages. English is considered Germanic, but has a huge amount of Latin vocabulary. Spanish developed from Latin, so we can identify Latin words in English and use patterns to convert them into Spanish. This gives us around 3,000 words.
sourceTranscript: English and Spanish are two related languages.
steps.pedagogicalGoal: Connect English Latin vocabulary to Spanish; introduce patterns rather than memorization.
requiredIdeas: Connect English Latin vocabulary to Spanish; introduce patterns rather than memorization.
understandingRubric: Connect English Latin vocabulary to Spanish; introduce patterns rather than memorization.
